service.description: The operations of the lossless XML layer (plans/design-dev-aide.md 5.2) on a text: set, remove and rename an attribute, insert, remove, move and replace an element, set an element's text, wrap and unwrap, each element named by a path of child indexes or a selector. Answers the new text and each operation's edits (byte and UTF-16 ranges), which an editor dispatches as one transaction; the rest of the text is unchanged. Pure text: nothing is read or written.

parameter.name: ops
parameter.description: A list of operations, or the JSON text of one: {op: "set-attribute", at: [0, 2] or "services/service[verb=run]", name, value}, and the like.

service.description: Shut the server down gracefully, as on SIGTERM, and run it again with the same arguments: the fallback for what does not reload (an entity change, a conf or component change). Sessions and the sim overlay are lost. Answers at once; the shutdown waits for open requests.
